rationale: The thesis remains intact: price at $8.14 is still below session VWAP ($8.27) and below the $8.29 invalidation, the bounce off the $7.96 low is unfolding on fading volume (60k→14k→39k→18k per 1m bar) with no news and a risk-off tape (SPY -0.66%, VIXY +2.89%), which matches the weak-bounce structure we shorted.
